headline: EPS rises sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Meritz Financial Group reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩4,670, up 19.0% q/q from ₩3,926 and up 15.6% y/y from ₩4,041.
summary_long: EPS of ₩4,670 rose 19.0% sequentially from ₩3,926 and 15.6% year-over-year from ₩4,041. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
